newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST-Norske Skog Q1 profits seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Norske Skog Q1 profits seen down.

text.p: Norwegian forestry group Norske Skog ASA is expected to post a first-quarter pre-tax profit of 175 million crowns, down from 601 million in the year-ago period, according to a consensus forecast by seven analysts polled by Reuters.
As many as six analysts had a buy recommendation on the share, while one had a hold recommendation.
They were generally positive on the forestry sector and believed prices had now reached their lowest levels and would rise both for newsprint and pulp.
Several said Norske Skog was reasonably priced compared to competitors in Europe and the United States.

They welcomed Norske Skog's plans, announced on April 16, to invest 2.8 billion crowns in expanding production at its newsprint plant in Golbey, France. This would increase profitability, the analysts said.
Norske Skog will present the result for the first quarter on Wednesday at 0615 GMT.
